entries.speaker: Hold Up
entries.en: Once you have knocked every enemy down,[n]you will gain complete control of the[n]battle and a [clr 2]Hold Up[clr 27] will occur.

entries.speaker: Hold Up
entries.en: If you press [clr 2][f 1 10 27][clr 27] during a Hold Up, [n]your whole team will perform an All-Out Attack.
